invariants.rationale: The method assigns data based on the WorkloadProfile so the profile should not be null at entry.
The method expects a valid HoodieEngineContext to process inserts, so it should be non-null.
The method iterates over partition paths from the profile, so getPartitionPaths() must not return null.
Partition paths may be empty, but if not, there will be at least one partition path.
The method relies on config for settings, so it should be initialized.
